name: stackoverflow
description: Search Stack Overflow questions, get a specific question with its answers, search by tag, or find top answerers for a tag.

action.description: search: title keyword search. get_question: a specific question + its answers by ID. by_tag: questions filtered by tag. top_answerers: reputation leaders for a tag.

question_id.description: Numeric question ID. Required for action='get_question'.

tag.description: Stack Overflow tag (e.g. 'python', 'fastapi'). Required for by_tag and top_answerers, optional filter for search.
